summary: Signet Jewelers filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement, a US-style buyback mechanism, with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. on September 10, 2026. Signet paid $125 million on September 11, 2026 and received an initial delivery of roughly 1,023,000 common shares. Final share count is based on daily volume-weighted average prices less a discount, with settlement expected between September 25 and December 2, 2026. About $575 million remains authorized under the 2017 program. Watch settlement adjustments, delivery direction risk, and buyback support for the stock.
